basic_details.job_title: IIM Lucknow Research Associate Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Indian Institute of Management Lucknow has invited applications for one contractual Research Associate 'A' or 'B' position in the Marketing Management Area under Professor Sushant Kumar, with a consolidated monthly fellowship of Rs.60,000/- to Rs.65,000/- plus HRA as per applicable norms. The initial period is 12 months. Applications are made through a Google Form, and the last date to apply is 20 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Open the Google Form given in the notice: https://forms.gle/GBGWyMDfD5tPxZLTA
Fill in the key details the notice names: photo, resume, total marks and work experience.
Apply on or before 20 November 2026. Applications received after the last date, or with incomplete information, will be rejected.
For any query, the notice gives the email address [email protected].
important_instructions: Incomplete or ineligible applications will be deemed invalid and rejected without intimation to the candidate. Only eligible candidates will be called for the interview. Only selected candidates will be intimated. No other query will be entertained. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview, if called for. Canvassing through any means will be taken seriously, and the candidate is liable to be rejected.

content_sections.heading: IIM Lucknow Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: Marketing Management Area (under Professor Sushant Kumar)
Initial period of 12 months, which may be extended based on performance and institute requirements
Consolidated monthly fellowship of Rs.60,000/- to Rs.65,000/-, plus HRA as per applicable norms
IIM Lucknow, Prabandh Nagar, IIM Road, Lucknow

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice lists two educational qualifications: Preference will be given to candidates with experience in primary data collection and analysis. Proficiency in Excel, AMOS, R, NVIVO, and other data analysis software is preferred. At least one research publication in a peer-reviewed journal, national or international, reflecting the ability to conduct independent research. Preference shall be given to candidates who have demonstrated research experience in publishing high-quality research papers in reputed (ABDC A, ABS 3 and above) journals. A Ph.D. with a minimum of two years of post-PhD research experience is preferred.

rows.essential_qualification: 1) Ph.D preferably in Management or relevant field, demonstrating strong research competence and subject expertise. 2) Postgraduate degree / MBA or relevant field from a reputed/recognised institute or university (regular mode) with a minimum of 60% marks.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated monthly fellowship in the range of Rs.60,000/- to Rs.65,000/-, depending upon qualifications and relevant experience, plus HRA as per applicable norms. The remuneration will be offered within this range and will be commensurate with the qualifications and experience of the candidate. The position is purely contractual in nature. The selected candidate will be appointed for an initial period of 12 months, which may be extended further based on performance and institute requirements.

content_sections.heading: IIM Lucknow Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice describes the job specification as assisting the faculty member in research, including but not limited to: conducting literature reviews; conceptualizing, designing, writing, and conducting research projects; primary and secondary data collection and analysis; writing academic reports and research papers.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIM Lucknow Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the Google Form given in the notice: https://forms.gle/GBGWyMDfD5tPxZLTA Fill in the key details the notice names: photo, resume, total marks and work experience. Apply on or before 20 November 2026. Applications received after the last date, or with incomplete information, will be rejected. For any query, the notice gives the email address [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Incomplete or ineligible applications will be deemed invalid and rejected without intimation to the candidate. Only eligible candidates will be called for the interview. Only selected candidates will be intimated. No other query will be entertained. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview, if called for. Canvassing through any means will be taken seriously, and the candidate is liable to be rejected.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIM Lucknow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one position of Research Associate 'A' or 'B' in the Marketing Management Area under Professor Sushant Kumar.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Lucknow Research Associate post?
faq.answer: The last date to apply is 20 November 2026. Applications received after the last date, or with incomplete information, will be rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the IIM Lucknow Research Associate post?
faq.answer: The notice asks for a Ph.D preferably in Management or relevant field, and a postgraduate degree / MBA or relevant field from a reputed/recognised institute or university (regular mode) with a minimum of 60% marks.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the IIM Lucknow Research Associate?
faq.answer: The selected candidate receives a consolidated monthly fellowship of Rs.60,000/- to Rs.65,000/-, depending upon qualifications and relevant experience, plus HRA as per applicable norms.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the IIM Lucknow Research Associate position?
faq.answer: Fill the Google Form given in the notice and mention the key details: photo, resume, total marks and work experience.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: All applications are scrutinized, and only shortlisted candidates are contacted by email for an online interview. Final selection is based on qualifications, relevant experience and performance in the online interaction.

faq.question: Q7. Is the IIM Lucknow Research Associate job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The position is purely contractual, with an initial period of 12 months that may be extended based on performance and institute requirements.

faq.question: Q8. Will TA/DA be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview, if called for.

faq.question: Q9. Will the interview be held in person?
faq.answer: No. The interview will be conducted in the online mode only, and shortlisted candidates are contacted by email.
